when.quote: When a customer requests a replacement debit card (due to lost, stolen, damaged, or other reasons), the replacement policies vary based on the customer's checking account tier.

starts.note: customer: start when the customer asks for a replacement or new debit card, or says yes when asked after a closure. Order only with the options, fees and mailing address the customer has confirmed.
starts.quote: Ask if they want to order a replacement card immediately

tools.not_used: The old card is closed in closing_cancelling_a_debit_card before a replacement is ordered.
Doc 005 is cited only for its tier list. No account is closed.

info.about: The checking account the new card links to
info.ask: Which checking account should the new card be linked to?

info.about: STANDARD, EXPEDITED or RUSH, limited by tier
info.ask: Which shipping speed would you like? Here are the fees for your account tier.
Which card design would you like: Classic, Premium metallic, or Custom? Here are the fees for your account tier.

info.about: The address to mail the card to. It may differ from the home address (for example a work address) but must be a US domestic address.
info.ask: What address should we mail the new card to? Should it be the address on file?

info.about: The account's type, class (tier), status, balance and date_opened; its cards' status, issue_reason and date_issued; the customer's DOB and address

steps.do: If the customer was not verified earlier in this conversation, verify them first: lookup, 2 matching values, get_current_time, log_verification. Otherwise reuse the verified user.

When replacements are wanted for cards on several checking accounts, run the steps below once per account, each with its own tier: for example, a Mid-tier account can be ordered now while an Entry-tier account waits 48 hours after its closure. Ask delivery and design separately for each.
steps.if: the customer wants replacements for more than one account
steps.quote: When a customer requests a replacement debit card (due to lost, stolen, damaged, or other reasons), the replacement policies vary based on the customer's checking account tier.

steps.do: Unlock get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847, then call it to read each account's type, class (tier), status, balance and date_opened.
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Unlock get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823, then call it for the target account (after any closure) to read each card's status, issue_reason and date_issued.
steps.quote: Use get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823 to look up all debit cards associated with a specific checking account.

steps.do: Read the customer's date_of_birth and address.
steps.quote: Customer must be at least 18 years old (verify using date_of_birth)

steps.do: Get the current time for the business-day, 12-month and 48-hour checks.
steps.quote: Account must have been open for at least 3 business days (excluding weekends)

steps.do:
Check eligibility:
1. account_type is checking.
2. Status is OPEN.
3. The account has been open at least 3 business days.
4. The balance is at least $25.
5. There is no other ACTIVE or PENDING card on the account.
6. The customer is at least 18.
7. The address is US domestic.
If a check fails, explain what blocks the order and stop.
steps.quote: Cards with issue_reason of 'new_account', 'first_card', 'expired', 'upgrade', or 'bank_reissue' do NOT count toward the replacement limit.

steps.do: Find each account's tier from its name: Light Blue, Light Green and Green Fee-Free are ENTRY; Blue Account and Green Account (checking) are MID; Evergreen is PREMIUM; Bluest is ELITE.

Count the replacement cards (issue_reason lost, stolen, fraud or damaged) issued in the last 12 months. Over the limit: Entry (2) waits or pays a $25 excess fee; Mid (3) waits or pays $15; Premium (5) must wait, with no fee option; Elite is unlimited. If the limit is reached, explain the wait or the fee.
steps.quote: 3) Check the date_issued field and count cards issued within the last 12 months

steps.do: For an ENTRY-tier account, tell the customer a replacement cannot be ordered until 48 hours after the card was closed, and give the earliest time. Also say only standard shipping is available. Do not order now.
steps.if: the account is ENTRY tier and less than 48 hours have passed since the closure
steps.quote: - 48-hour waiting period after card closure before a replacement can be ordered

steps.do: Ask for the delivery option and state the tier's fee: ENTRY STANDARD $0 only; MID STANDARD $0, EXPEDITED $15; PREMIUM STANDARD or EXPEDITED $0, RUSH $35; ELITE all $0. Timeframes: STANDARD 7-10, EXPEDITED 3-5, RUSH 1-2 business days.
steps.if: the account's tier allows ordering now

steps.do: Explain the tier's shipping and design fees. If the customer asks for the best free options, choose the highest-value $0 options for the tier: Premium EXPEDITED and the PREMIUM design, both $0; Elite RUSH and any design, all $0; Mid and Entry STANDARD and CLASSIC.
steps.if: the customer asks for the best free options
steps.quote: Free expedited shipping on all replacements (delivery_fee: $0 for both STANDARD and EXPEDITED)

steps.do: Ask for the card design and state the tier's fee: ENTRY and MID CLASSIC $0, PREMIUM $10, CUSTOM $25; PREMIUM tier CLASSIC $0, PREMIUM $0, CUSTOM $15; ELITE all $0.
steps.quote: 5) Ask customer for preferred card design (CLASSIC, PREMIUM, or CUSTOM) and explain fees.

steps.do: Confirm the mailing address the customer wants (US domestic). If they give an address other than the one on file, such as a work address, take it in full and read it back. Before ordering, tell the customer that any fee (delivery, design, excess replacement) will be deducted from the linked checking account.
steps.quote: Always inform the customer that the fee will be deducted from their checking account balance before placing the order.

steps.do: Unlock order_debit_card_5739, then order the card with the exact tier fees, using the parameter names the unlock reports.

args.reason: the replacement reason (e.g. lost, stolen, fraud), if the tool asks for one

steps.if: eligible: check_order passed, no tier wait is pending, the replacement limit is met or the excess fee accepted, and the customer confirmed the options and fees
steps.quote: When using order_debit_card_5739, you must provide the exact delivery_fee and design_fee amounts based on the tier rules below.

steps.do: Tell the customer the delivery timeframe and the fees charged. If the order failed (for example, insufficient funds for the fees), explain why.
steps.quote: 8) Inform customer of expected delivery timeframe and any applicable fees

steps.do: If the order fails and the customer cannot resolve the cause (for example, by adding funds to cover the fees), explain what failed and ask whether they want a human agent. Transfer only if they say yes.

args.summary: the replacement order attempted and the error

steps.if: order returned an error the customer cannot resolve and the customer agrees to a transfer
steps.quote: If the account has insufficient funds for delivery or design fees, the order will fail

rules.rule: ENTRY tier (Light Blue, Light Green, Green Fee-Free): 48-hour wait after closure, standard shipping only, delivery_fee $0, at most 2 replacements per rolling 12 months
rules.quote: - Standard shipping only (no expedited option available) - delivery_fee: $0

rules.rule: MID tier: at most 3 replacements per rolling 12 months, no waiting period
rules.quote: - No waiting period - can order immediately after closure

rules.rule: The CLASSIC design costs $0 at every tier
Only 1 active debit card per checking account, and no pending order may already exist for the account
rules.quote: 8) Customer cannot have a pending debit card order for the same account (check debit_cards table for PENDING status)

rules.rule: Premium tier: up to 5 replacements per 12 months, no waiting period, STANDARD and EXPEDITED at $0, RUSH at $35. PREMIUM design $0, CUSTOM $15, CLASSIC $0.
Entry tier: 2 replacements per 12 months, a 48-hour wait after closure, and STANDARD shipping only at $0. The PREMIUM design costs $10 and CUSTOM $25.
rules.quote: 48-hour waiting period after card closure before a replacement can be ordered

rules.rule: Mid tier: 3 replacements per 12 months, no wait, STANDARD $0 or EXPEDITED $15
Only one active debit card is allowed per checking account
rules.quote: Customer cannot have more than 1 active debit cards per checking account

rules.rule: The account must hold at least $25
rules.quote: Account must have a minimum balance of $25 (to cover potential fees)

rules.rule: Cards ship to US domestic addresses only
rules.quote: Customer's address on file must be a valid US domestic address (international shipping is not available)

rules.rule: Entry tier over 2 replacements in 12 months: wait or pay $25
rules.quote: If customer has exceeded the 2-card limit, they must wait until oldest replacement ages out of the 12-month window, OR pay a $25 excess replacement fee

rules.rule: Premium tier over 5 replacements: must wait, with no fee option
rules.quote: If customer has exceeded the 5-card limit, they must wait until oldest replacement ages out (no fee option - must wait)

rules.rule: Elite tier: every delivery option is free
rules.quote: Complimentary shipping on all replacements (delivery_fee: $0 for STANDARD, EXPEDITED, and RUSH)

rules.rule: An order fails if the account cannot cover the fees
rules.quote: If the account has insufficient funds for delivery or design fees, the order will fail

rules.rule: Only cards with issue_reason lost, stolen, fraud or damaged count as replacements toward the tier limit
rules.quote: 2) Look for cards with issue_reason of 'lost', 'stolen', 'fraud', or 'damaged'

rules.rule: Mid-tier excess replacements: wait, or pay $15
rules.quote: If customer has exceeded the 3-card limit, they must wait until oldest replacement ages out, OR pay a $15 excess replacement fee

rules.rule: The card is mailed to the address the customer confirms. This may be an alternate US address, such as a work address.
rules.quote: Confirm the address that the customer would like to mail the card to.

done_when: For each account the customer wants a replacement on, one of these is true. (1) The replacement is ordered to the address the customer confirmed (on file or alternate), with the correct tier fees, and the customer knows the timeframe and fees. (2) The customer was told why it cannot be ordered now (eligibility, the tier limit, or the Entry 48-hour wait) and when it can. (3) The customer declined a replacement.
